libraryDevices.title: Database
libraryDevices.intro: Find the boardviews, schematics and BIOS candidates of each motherboard in your own folders. Nothing leaves this computer, and your files are not changed.
libraryDevices.privacy: Local only: no network, no upload. Your original files are never changed, moved or renamed.
libraryDevices.roots.heading: Root folders
libraryDevices.roots.empty: No folder selected yet. Choose a folder to start.
libraryDevices.roots.removeNote: Removing a folder only removes it from the index. The files on disk stay where they are.
libraryDevices.scan.heading: Scan
libraryDevices.scan.stepsHint: Optional steps can be switched off. The rest keeps working.
libraryDevices.scan.paused: Paused. Nothing is lost; resume to continue.
libraryDevices.scan.cancelled: Cancelled. Results found so far stay listed.
libraryDevices.tree.heading: Folder hierarchy
libraryDevices.tree.incomplete: Incomplete: a limit or an unreadable folder stopped the map.
